title: Aureline M5 AI review finding
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for one inspectable AI review finding row. Names the object class, its review association, the finding class, the severity / confidence, the analyzed diff scope, and the lifecycle state (open, dismissed, published, outdated, suppressed, rerun recommended) so a finding is never an unlabelled note and a stale finding never looks current. Downstream review detail, the AI review panel, finding rows, pending-review trays, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a finding's meaning by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
